capabilities: Render MyST admonitions, math, figures, and code directives in Reading view and Live Preview
Support inline roles and local label anchor references inside processed directives
Embed vault HTML files in sandboxed iframes with optional MathJax loading
Preserve the original Markdown source instead of rewriting it
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Mobile devices are untested. Embedded HTML scripts run in a sandboxed iframe but can contact third-party servers; internet access is needed for remote resources including the MathJax runtime.
motivation: Designed for technical notes, equations, and multilingual course material, including Hebrew.
problem: Obsidian's Markdown renderer does not understand MyST syntax used in Jupyter Book and Sphinx sources, so such notes show raw directives.

relations.evidence: Render MyST Markdown directly in your Obsidian notes while keeping your Jupyter Book and Sphinx source unchanged
Render MyST Markdown directly in your Obsidian notes while keeping your Jupyter Book and Sphinx source unchanged

summary: Reader that renders MyST Markdown directives, roles, math, and figures in Reading view and Live Preview while leaving source files unchanged.
